errors.text_span: Всички процентни стойности са изписани вътре в съответните сектори.
errors.evidence: The description states that all sectors have percentage values written inside them, but only two of the four sectors have labels (57.1% for yellow and 26.2% for grey). The blue and orange sectors do not have percentage labels.

errors.text_span: а по-малките сектори са разположени последователно в посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged sequentially by size in a clockwise direction. This is incorrect. Moving clockwise from the top, the sectors are Blue (smallest), Orange (second smallest), Grey (second largest), and Yellow (largest), which is not a sequential order. The sectors are arranged sequentially by decreasing size in a counter-clockwise direction.

errors.text_span: най-големият сектор (жълт) е разположен в дясната част
errors.evidence: Describing the largest (yellow) sector as being in the 'right part' is ambiguous and imprecise. The sector spans the bottom-right, bottom-left, and top-left quadrants of the chart, covering more of the left and bottom than the right.
